paragraphs: Markets over the last day: the eight tracked equity indices moved +1.22% on average, with Nikkei 225 strongest (+2.87%) and Hang Seng weakest (+0.44%). Brent crude changed +1.25% to 92.63. Gold changed -0.89% to 3,994.3. Bitcoin changed +0.22% to 73,884.8594. The US 10-year yield stands at 4.998%, a relative move of +0.30%. Among the firms tracked, Freeport-McMoRan (+3.00%) and Glencore (+2.20%) moved the most.
